images.note: Two standard gold Riddell helmets (white facemask, no decal) on a glass shelf inside a retail display case, 3/4 front-right angle, taken 2013-11-23. Helmet region is roughly x 2000-3250, y 1930-3200 in the full image (about 1,250 px wide). Sharp: metal-flake texture is resolved. Not isolated: behind glass with ceiling-light glare and reflections, a price card in front, other merchandise around it, so it needs cropping or cutout work.
images.face_check: No face is visible through or around the helmets; nobody is wearing or holding them. Caveat: the case glass at upper center (roughly x 1430-2330, y 1000-2070, left of and above the helmets) holds a faint reflection of the photographer, partly hidden by the camera. Crop to the helmet region before any use.
